title: Notice Rates on Voluntary Change Fees
content:
**Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — notice given on a voluntary change.** The change fee of a voluntary, standard exchange is multiplied by the **notice rate**, which follows the whole days from the date of that exchange to the first departure of the new itinerary. The rate acts on the unrounded fee; the fee is rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Whole days from the exchange date to the new itinerary's first departure | Notice rate |
|---|---|
| 14 or more (long notice) | 0.8 |
| At least 7 (short notice) and fewer than 14 | 0.9 |
| Fewer than 7 | 1 |

The exchange is the latest standard exchange recorded on the ticket; its date and the first departure of its new itinerary are those recorded on that exchange entry.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, exchange dated 2 May)

| New itinerary departs | Days | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 16 May | 14 | 0.8 |
| 15 May | 13 | 0.9 |
| 9 May | 7 | 0.9 |
| 8 May | 6 | 1 |
